Heights Alliance Dorms.text: Every U.A. Academy student lives on campus in Heights Alliance from the first day of the first year; nobody commutes. Each Hero Course class in all three years has its own five-story building, and the General Studies, Support and Management students share larger halls at the far end of the yard, with all three courses mixed on every floor. A Hero Course building has a ground-floor lounge with a big television, a kitchen and a dining table that seats the whole class, a laundry room and baths; upstairs, the men's and women's wings hold private rooms with a bed, desk, closet and balcony, which residents furnish as they please. The shared halls add quiet study rooms and a ventilated workroom for Support residents. The rules are simple and enforced. Curfew falls each night, faculty walk rounds after dark, and anyone caught outside after it earns house arrest and cleaning duty. Door readers log every entry. Leaving campus means signing out on the building's sheet, and the Main Gate passes students only when they are signed out; a missing sign-out reaches the homeroom teacher by morning. Residents may visit each other's rooms until curfew. Many go home on weekends, and the Sunday-evening return is the busiest hour at the gate. Cooking, cleaning and laundry run on rotas that every building argues over. The dorms make U.A. a whole life: classmates are neighbors, rivals share a kitchen, and nothing that happens in a lounge stays private for long. Rooms (floor + slot; men's wing 01-04, women's 05-08): Class 1-A follows Aizawa's canon plan: 2F Mineta 201, Midoriya 202, Aoyama 203, Tokoyami 204; 3F Koda 301, Kaminari 302, Iida 303, Ojiro 304, Jiro 305, Hagakure 308; 4F Shoji 401, Kirishima 402, Bakugo 403, Uraraka 405, Ashido 408; 5F Sato 502, Todoroki 503, Sero 504, Yaoyorozu 505, Asui 508; the rest stand empty. Class 1-B's building is numbered the same way.
